inventory.description:
Poli Marichal
, (Ponce, P.R., 1956)
Artista gráfica, pintora, diseñadora gráfica, dibujante y cineasta experimental. Comenzó sus estudios con su padre, Carlos Marichal y más adelante con Myrna Báez. Estudia las técnicas de retablo y policromía en La Escola Massana de Barcelona por dos años. En 1977 obtiene un Bachillerato en Bellas Artes con especialización en Artes Gráficas de la Escuela de Artes Plásticas de San Juan y en 1982 una Maestría en Bellas Artes con especialización en Cine Experimental. Es miembro fundador del colectivo de grabado, Los de Abajo y ha colaborado con el taller de grabado La Mano Press en Los Ángeles, California. En 1999, el Museo de Arte Moderno de Nueva York seleccionó dos de sus películas experimentales para la retrospectiva Big as Life: An American History of 8mm Films y en el 2006 varias de sus películas fueron incluidas en la muestra Rewind, rewind…, organizada por el Instituto de Cultura Puertorriqueña.
Poli Marichal
, (Ponce, P.R., 1956)
Graphic artist, painter, graphic designer, draftswoman and experimental filmmaker. She began her studies with her father, Carlos Marichal and later with Myrna Báez. She studied the techniques of altarpiece and polychromy at La Escola Massana in Barcelona for two years. In 1977 he obtained a Bachelor of Fine Arts with a specialization in Graphic Arts from the Escuela de Artes Plásticas de San Juan and in 1982 a Master of Fine Arts with a specialization in Experimental Film. She is a founding member of the printmaking collective, Los de Abajo and has collaborated with the printmaking workshop La Mano Press in Los Angeles, California. In 1999, the Museum of Modern Art in New York selected two of her experimental films for the retrospective 
Big as Life: An American History of 8mm Films
 and in 2006 several of his films were included in the exhibition 
Rewind, rewind…
, organized by the IInstituto de Cultura Puertorriqueña.

Tallador. Doradeño nacido en Nueva York, miembro fundador del grupo de talla “La Gubia Dorada”. Cosme participa de ferias en diferentes municipios de Puerto Rico, como la Feria de Artesanía Bacardí, en Cataño, el Encuentro de Santeros de Orocovis, la Feria de Artesanías de Plaza las Américas y la Feria de Artesanías de San Juan, en las cuales ha recibido más de quince premios. A nivel local, sus piezas se exhiben en la Casa del Rey, en Dorado, el Museo Casa Alonso, en Vega Baja, el Museo Francisco Oller, en Bayamón y el Museo de Arte e Historia de San Juan. Además, sus piezas han sido exhibidas en el Museo de Arte de Ponce, formaron parte del Pesebre Colectivo del Chase Manhattan Bank y representaron a Puerto Rico en el Smithsonian Museum, en Washington D.C.
Alfredo Cosme Reyes
 (Nueva York, EU, 1959)
Carver. Doradeño born in New York, founding member of the carving group “La Gubia Dorada”. Cosme participates in fairs in different municipalities of Puerto Rico, such as the Bacardi Crafts Fair in Cataño, the Encuentro de Santeros de Orocovis, the Plaza las Americas Crafts Fair and the San Juan Crafts Fair, in which he has received more than fifteen awards. Locally, his pieces are exhibited at the Casa del Rey in Dorado, the Casa Alonso Museum in Vega Baja, the Francisco Oller Museum in Bayamón and the San Juan Museum of Art and History. In addition, his pieces have been exhibited at the Museo de Arte de Ponce, were part of the Chase Manhattan Bank’s Collective Nativity Scene, and represented Puerto Rico at the Smithsonian Museum in Washington D.C.

inventory.name: Ismo (Joshua Santos) – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Ismo (Joshua Santos)
 (Arecibo, PR, 1981)
Graffitero, pintor y creador de instalaciones. Posee estudios de la Escuela de Artes Plásticas de Puerto Rico. Este artista, también conocido como “Bik” o “Bik-Ismo”, trabaja el arte urbano desde hace trece años; utilizando como símbolo distintivo una tostadora y la frase “Seguimos tostando”. Ha formado parte de varios grupos internacionales de arte urbano como FX., The Nasty Boys y Masters of Destruction. Fue el primer artista en curar y organizar una exhibición de graffiti sobre tela en Puerto Rico, titulada Virtuosos del Aerosol (Galería Enlaces, 2002) y la exhibición titulada ExhibicionIsmo (Galería Enlaces, 2003). Fue uno de los estudiantes escogidos por la Escuela de Artes Plásticas para visitar la Feria de Arco en Madrid, España (2002). En noviembre del 2007 viajó a Boston para pintar con diferentes artistas. Su obra se ha exhibido en Puerto Rico, Estados Unidos y Japón. Le interesa trabajar con los íconos de la cultura puertorriqueña y la estética del graffiti.
Ismo (Santos, Joshua)
 (Arecibo, PR, 1981)
Graffiti artist, painter, and installation creator. He has studied at the Puerto Rico School of Plastic Arts. This artist, also known as “Bik” o “Bik-Ismo”, has worked in urban art for the past thirteen years, using as a distinctive symbol a toaster and the phrase “Seguimos Tostando” (“We’re Still Toasting”). He has belonged to several international urban art groups, such as FX, The Nasty Boys, and Masters of Destruction. He was the first artist to curate and organize an exhibition of graffiti on fabric in Puerto Rico, Virtuosos del Aerosol (Aerosol Virtuosos) at Enlaces Gallery in 2002, and the exhibition entitled ExhibicionIsmo (ExhibitionIsm) at Enlaces Gallery in 2003. He was one of the students chosen by the School of Visual Arts to visit the Arco Fair in Madrid, Spain (2002). In November 2007, he traveled to Boston to paint with different artists. He has exhibited his work in Puerto Rico, the United States, and Japan. He is interested in working with the icons of Puerto Rican culture and the aesthetics of graffiti.

inventory.name: Susana Herrero Kundhart – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Susana Herrero Kundhart
 (Nueva York, EU, 1945)
Artista gráfica, dibujante y pintora. En 1967 obtuvo su Bachillerato en Arte de la Universidad de Puerto Rico (UPR), en Mayagüez y en 1970 su Maestría en Arte en la Universidad de Missouri; también tomó cursos intermedios de arte en la Universidad Interamericana de San Germán. En 1989 ocupó la dirección interina del Departamento de Bellas Artes de la UPR en Río Piedras y contribuyó significativamente a la incorporación del intaglio, la litografía y la colografía al currículo universitario. Fue profesora de la Escuela de Artes Plásticas de Puerto Rico y actualmente continúa ejerciendo dicha labor en la UPR, Recinto de Río Piedras. Enseñó dibujo y grabado en la Liga de Estudiantes de Arte de San Juan, y fundó allí el primer taller de intaglio y litografía. Ha recibido invitaciones honorarias de bienales y trienales europeas por jurado internacional. Su obra se ha difundido en las más prestigiosas exposiciones internacionales en el Caribe, los Estados Unidos, Latinoamérica, Japón y extensamente por Europa. Sus litografías y dibujos se distinguen por sus sinuosas líneas y sus figuras, basadas en la anatomía humana, aisladas y flotando en el espacio visual.
www.artaddiction.net/members/herrero/he…
Susana Herrero Kundhart
 (New York, US, 1945)
Graphic artist, draftswoman, and painter. In 1967 she obtained her Bachelor of Arts from the University of Puerto Rico (UPR), Mayagüez campus, and in 1970 her Master of Arts from the University of Missouri. Additionally, she studied intermediate level art courses at Inter American University in San Germán. In 1989 she was interim director of the Fine Arts Department of the UPR Río Piedras campus and contributed significantly to the inclusion of intaglio, lithography, and colography into Department curriculum. She was professor at the Puerto Rico School of Visual Arts and at the UPR, Río Piedras campus. She taught drawing and engraving at the Art Students’ League of San Juan and established its first intaglio and lithography workshop. She has received honorary invitations from international juries to participate in European biennials and triennials. Her work has been disseminated throughout the most prestigious international exhibitions of the Caribbean, the United States, Latin America, Japan, and extensively through Europe. Her lithography and drawings are distinguished by their sinuous lines and their figures, based on human anatomy, which appear isolated and floating in the visual space.

inventory.description:
Favián Vergara
 (Guadalajara, México,1958 )
Comenzó a pintar bajo consulta técnica de Jorge Marín, pero es importante señalar que su desarrollo como artista plástico ha sido de forma autodidacta. Es conocido por trabajar en “medio mixto”, como óleo sobre estuco en madera. Sin embargo, no se limita a este medio, como podemos observar por sus trabajos en escultura y fotografía. Esta última es una constante en su trabajo creativo. Sus obras han sido exhibidas en México, Estados Unidos, Alemania, España, Francia e Italia.
Favián Vergara (Guadalajara, Mexico,1958 )
He began painting under the technical consultation of Jorge Marín, but it is important to point out that his development as a plastic artist has been self-taught. He is known for working in “mixed media”, such as oil on wood stucco. However, he does not limit himself to this medium, as we can see from his work in sculpture and photography. The latter is a constant in his creative work. His works have been exhibited in Mexico, United States, Germany, Spain, France and Italy.

inventory.name: Mercedes Quiñones – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Mercedes Quiñones
 (Cali, Colombia, 1951 – San Juan, PR, 1999)
Dibujante, pintora y profesora. Llegó a Puerto Rico de adolescente junto a su familia que se estableció en Peñuelas, el pueblo de origen de su familia paterna. Estudió Psicología en la Universidad de Puerto Rico. En la década del ochenta comenzó a dibujar y formó parte de la Asociación de Artistas Abstractos. Fue profesora de dibujo y pintura en Casa Candina, la Escuela de Artes Plásticas de Puerto Rico y la Liga de Estudiantes de Arte de San Juan. Presidió, desde 1994 hasta su deceso, la Asociación de Mujeres Artistas de Puerto Rico. Amante de los libros y la poesía, estableció una estrecha relación entre la literatura y la plástica, al presentar en sus piezas al libro como objeto plástico y la caligrafía como elemento pictórico. Sus obras le merecieron varios premios, entre ellos: el premio Exposición Individual/Artista Local (por la exposición de 1995 Homenaje al libro) conferido por la Asociación Internacional de Críticos de Arte del capítulo de Puerto Rico; y el Primer Premio en Pintura del Certamen de Artes Plásticas del Ateneo Puertorriqueño, por la obra 
Quemar las naves
. En mayo de 1999 el Municipio de Peñuelas inauguró en su honor la sala de exposiciones Mercedes Quiñones.
Mercedes Quiñones
 (Cali, Colombia, 1951 – San Juan, PR, 1999)
Draftswoman, painter, and professor. She arrived on the island as a teenager to live in Peñuelas, her father’s hometown. She studied psychology at the University of Puerto Rico. She started drawing in the eighties and became a member of the Association of Abstract Artists. She taught drawing and painting at Casa Candina, the Puerto Rico School of Visual Arts, and the San Juan League of Art Students. She was president of the Puerto Rico Association of Women Artists from 1994 until the time of her death. A lover of books and poetry, she established a close relationship in her work between literature and the visual arts by including books as objects and calligraphy as a graphic element. Her work received several awards, including: Individual Exhibition/Local Artist (for her 1995 exhibition Homenaje al libro (Homage to Books), from the Puerto Rico Chapter of the International Association of Art Critics, and First Prize in Painting at the Ateneo Puertorriqueño’s Plastic Arts Competition for her piece 
Quemar las naves (Burning Bridges)
. In May 1999, the Municipality of Peñuelas inaugurated the Mercedes Quiñones exhibition hall in her honor.

Eric H. French Circuns
 (Indiana, EEUU, 1969)
Pintor, fotógrafo, dibujante, escultor, artista digital y videoartista. De niño se mudó a Puerto Rico con su familia. Recibió el Primer Premio de Pintura en la Bienal de Arte Joven del Chase Manhattan Bank, un año antes de culminar su Bachillerato en Bellas Artes de la Escuela de Artes Plásticas de Puerto Rico en 1994. En 1996 culminó sus estudios de Maestría en Bellas Artes en Savannah Collage of Art and Design de Georgia, donde recibió la beca Malcom Propes por el mejor portafolio de estudiante. Regresó a Puerto Rico en 1996 y actualmente trabaja como profesor de la Escuela de Artes Plásticas y la Universidad de Puerto Rico. La gran fuerza expresiva del color es característica fundamental de su obra pictórica, trabajando medios mixtos con gruesos impastos, en ocasiones aplicados directamente del tubo. A veces hace sus propios pigmentos y trabaja con la noción de métodos tradicionales versus no tradicionales.
www.saatchionline.com/french
Eric H. French Circuns
 (Indiana, EU, 1969)
Painter, photographer, draftsman, sculptor, digital artist, and video artist. As a child, he moved to Puerto Rico with his family. He received First Prize in Painting at Chase Manhattan Bank’s Young Art Biennial a year before he completed his Bachelor of Fine Arts at the Puerto Rico School of Plastic Arts in 1994. In 1996 he completed his Master of Fine Arts at the Savannah College of Art and Design in Georgia, where he received the Malcolm Propes Fellowship for best student portfolio. He returned to Puerto Rico in 1996 and currently works as a professor at the School of Visual Arts and the University of Puerto Rico. A fundamental characteristic of his pictorial work is an enormous expressive strength of color, using mixed media with thick impastos that are sometimes applied directly from the tube. At times he makes his own pigments and works with the notion of traditional versus non traditional methods.

inventory.name: Ladis Place – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Ladis Place, Salinas – 1968
RESTAURANT LADI’S PLACE 
PLAYA DE SALINAS 
Salinas, Puerto Rico
The design program called for the reconstruction of a traditional and very popular sea food restaurant. The project was to be financed by the owners and had to be constructed by stages without interrupting its continuous use. The maximum capacity was 1,000 meals per seating, yet the restaurant use was quite cyclical – serving over two thousand meals on a Sunday noon, but only two hundred on a week-day.
Hence, the design solution is a series of independent pavilions related together by a board walk. The kitchen was built first, then destroying the old kitchen and building the first dining room and so on. The kitchen design is very specialized to serve the house specialty – fried fish, onion sauce and plantains. All serving facilities are at level to be able to flow foods in carts. This dictated the over bridge at the entrance. The service facilities are totally separated and discreet to the patrons. The waiters circulate through the tunnel that serves all pavilions, while the customers circulate parallel to the sea. The wide balcony allows for additional seating on busy days. Construction began in 1972 and finalized in 1977 without a single day interruption.
The shape and form of the building are typical to the Salinas area. The building had to remain rustic and unpretentious as not to lose its clientele – the populace.
The garden wall and the front façade block the ocean view urban tradition of the area, only to gain full view of the sea entering through the access tunnel, a lush garden in contrast to the arid surroundings.
Technical Information:
Construction is concrete structure with wood and wood beam roofs. The roofs are urethane insulated to minimize heat loads. The kitchen and service rooms are concrete and concrete block and form part of the parking wall.
The dining rooms were designed to be air conditioned but construction came in the mist of the energy crisis and glass was substituted with screens adding ceiling fans for air movement. Only the bar pavilions remained air conditioned, and here, too, sliding window were added for natural ventilation option.

inventory.name: Margarita Vincenty – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Margarita Vincenty 
(1963)
Dentista de profesión y Artista por necesidad propia. A lo largo de su vida ha cursado clases de Arte siendo las más significativas en la década de los noventas junto a la reconocida artista y educadora, Mercedes Quiñones (epd) en la Casa Candina. Mercedes prosiguió siendo su maestra y mentora fuera de Candina. Posteriormente Vincenty tomó varios cursos en La Liga de Arte de San Juan y en la Escuela de Artes Plásticas. El trabajo de Vincenty se ha presentado en exposiciones colectivas dentro y fuera de Puerto Rico, en espacios reconocidos como La Casa de los Contrafuertes (VSJ) y El Clemente Soto Vélez (Nueva York). Su obra es considerada por ella y varios curadores como un Arte Povera caribeño y sustentable. Actualmente vive y trabaja en Ponce, Puerto Rico.
Margarita Vincenty 
(1963)
Dentist by profession and artist by necessity. Throughout his life he has taken art classes, the most significant being in the nineties with the renowned artist and educator, Mercedes Quiñones (epd) at Casa Candina. Mercedes continued to be his teacher and mentor outside of Candina. Vincenty subsequently took several courses at La Liga de Arte de San Juan and at the Escuela de Artes Plásticas. Vincenty’s work has been presented in group exhibitions in Puerto Rico and abroad, in renowned venues such as La Casa de los Contrafuertes (VSJ) and El Clemente Soto Vélez (New York). Her work is considered by her and several curators as a Caribbean and sustainable Arte Povera. She currently lives and works in Ponce, Puerto Rico.

inventory.name: Jorge Rechany – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Jorge Rechany
 (San Juan, PR, 1914 – 1990)
Pintor, muralista y profesor. Estudió con el español Alejandro Sánchez Felipe en San Juan y con Ramón Frade en Cayey. De 1934 a 1954 vivió en Nueva York, donde estudió en National Academy of Design. En los años cincuenta regresó a Puerto Rico y se incorporó al movimiento artístico que estaba surgiendo. En 1958, becado por el Instituto de Cultura Puertorriqueña, estudió las técnicas del mosaico, el fresco y la pintura mural en el Instituto Nacional de Bellas Artes de México. Estudió en 1961 con Enrico Pandolfini, en Pietrasanta, Italia, donde posteriormente exhibió su obra. Participó en el diseño de los mosaicos de la cúpula del Capitolio de Puerto Rico. Fue Director de la sección de Artes Plásticas del Ateneo Puertorriqueño, profesor de la Liga de Estudiantes de Arte de San Juan y de la Universidad del Sagrado Corazón en Santurce. Desde 1984 fue nombrado miembro de la Academia de Artes, Historia y Arqueología de Puerto Rico. Cultivó la figura humana y el retrato con un enfoque de formas simplificadas y geométricas, dando primacía a la línea recta y el color.
Jorge Rechany
 (San Juan, PR, 1914 – 1990)
Painter, muralist, and professor. He studied with Spanish artist Alejandro Sánchez Felipe in San Juan and with Ramón Frade in Cayey. From 1934 to 1954 he lived in New York, where he studied at the National Academy of Design. He returned to Puerto Rico in the fifties and became involved in the rising artistic movement of the time. In 1958, with a scholarship from the Institute of Puerto Rican Culture, he studied mosaic techniques, fresco, and mural painting at the National Institute of Fine Arts of Mexico. He studied in 1961 with Enrico Pandolfini in Pietrasanta, Italy, where he later exhibited his work. He participated in designing the mosaics for the dome of the Puerto Rico Capitol Building. He was director of the Ateneo Puertorriqueño’s Plastic Arts Department, and professor at the San Juan League of Art Students and at Sacred Heart University in Santurce. He was appointed a member of the Puerto Rico Academy of Art, History, and Archeology in 1984. He worked in human figures and portraits, focusing on simplified geometric shapes and favoring straight lines and color.

inventory.name: Antonio Cortés Rolón – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Antonio Cortés Rolón
 (Cidra, P.R., 1951)
Pintor, educador, historiógrafo y museólogo. Sus estudios en arte comenzaron con el pintor estadounidense Henry Morgan, en Río Grande y luego con el artista puertorriqueño Edwin Maurás. Obtuvo su primer Bachillerato en Pedagogía con concentración en Arte de la Universidad Interamericana de Bayamón, Puerto Rico, en la cual fundó y dirigió el programa Artes Eclipse. Terminó un segundo Bachillerato en Bellas Artes en la Universidad Interamericana de San Germán. Estudió grabado con la artista Noemí Ruiz y participó en un seminario con el artista norteamericano Larry Rivers. En 1985 obtuvo su Maestría en Pintura y Dibujo de la Universidad de Nueva York y viajó a Boston, Detroit y Canadá. Ha ejercido como profesor en la Escuela de Artes Plásticas de Puerto Rico y la Universidad Interamericana de Bayamón. Durante un largo periodo se mantuvo viajando a España para exhibir su obra mientras cursaba sus estudios doctorales en Museología e Historiografía, los cuales finalizó en el 2005. Recibió dos distinciones en el 2004 de la Asociación Internacional de Críticos de Arte, por su exposición internacional en España y mejor exposición individual. Su obra ha sido expuesta en Puerto Rico, Estados Unidos, Francia, España, Alemania, República Dominicana y Guadalupe.
Antonio Cortés Rolón
 (Cidra, P.R., 1951)
Painter, educator, historiographer, and museologist. He began his art studies with American painter Henry Morgan in Río Grande, and later studied with Puerto Rican artist Edwin Maurás. He obtained his first Bachelor of Arts in Education with a major in Art from Inter American University in Bayamón, Puerto Rico, where he established and directed the Eclipse arts program. He completed a second Bachelor of Fine Arts at Inter American University in San Germán. He studied engraving with artist Noemí Ruiz and participated in a seminar with American artist Larry Rivers. In 1985 he obtained a Master of Arts in Painting and Drawing from New York University and traveled to Boston, Detroit, and Canada. He has worked as a professor at the Puerto Rico School of Visual Arts and at the Inter American University in Bayamón. He spent a long period of time traveling to Spain to exhibit his work while pursuing doctoral studies in Museology and Historiography, which he completed in 2005. In 2004 he received two distinctions from the International Association of Art Critics for his international exhibition in Spain and for best individual exhibition. His work has been shown in Puerto Rico, the United States, France, Spain, Germany, the Dominican Republic, and Guadeloupe.

José “Che” Flores,
 (Fajardo, P.R., 1944)
Ceramista, pintor y escultor. Obtuvo un Bachillerato en Artes Plásticas de la Escuela de Artes Plásticas de San Juan y más tarde, a través de un intercambio cultural, se traslada a México para estudiar en la Escuela de Artesanías Jalisciense donde además fue profesor de alfarería. Luego se traslada a la Academia de San Carlos “La Ciudadela” dedicándose a su obra. A su regreso a Puerto Rico, en 1975, trabajó para el gobierno organizando talleres de arte para las comunidades especiales y también se destacó como profesor en el Colegio La Piedad y en la Universidad de Puerto Rico. Entre los proyectos que ha colaborado se encuentran la restauración del Parque Luis Muñoz Rivera creando para esto los mosaicos que ahí se encuentran y la creación de tapices para la SKF y el Parador Gripiñas en Jayuya. El tema principal de su obra gira en torno a la cultura indígena puertorriqueña.
José “Che” Flores,
 (Fajardo, P.R., 1944)
Ceramist, painter and sculptor. He obtained a Bachelor of Fine Arts from the Escuela de Artes Plasticas de San Juan and later, through a cultural exchange, he moved to Mexico to study at the Escuela de Artesanías Jalisciense where he also taught pottery. He then moved to the Academia de San Carlos “La Ciudadela” to dedicate himself to his work. Upon his return to Puerto Rico, in 1975, he worked for the government organizing art workshops for special communities and also excelled as a teacher at the Colegio La Piedad and the University of Puerto Rico. Among the projects he has collaborated on are the restoration of the Luis Muñoz Rivera Park, creating the mosaics found there, and the creation of tapestries for the SKF and the Gripiñas Parador in Jayuya. The main theme of his work revolves around the Puerto Rican indigenous culture.

inventory.description:
Cecilio Colón Guzmán
 (Barranquitas, P.R., 1959)
Pintor. En 1976 comenzó a pintar y a dibujar de manera autodidacta. En 1981 obtuvo un Bachillerato en Bellas Artes con concentración en Pintura de la Universidad de Puerto Rico, Recinto de Río Piedras. Estudió bajo la tutela de Carmelo Fontánez, Lope Max Díaz, Susana Herrero, Luis Hernández Cruz y Luisa Géigel. Ha exhibido su obra, tanto individual como colectivamente, en museos, galerías y salas de exposición en Puerto Rico y el exterior. En 1979 recibió el primer premio de Arte Joven del Royal Bank of Canada en Hato Rey, Puerto Rico. También ha recibido premios del Ateneo Puertorriqueño, la Universidad de Puerto Rico y la Asociación de Críticos de Arte de Puerto Rico. En 1991 participó en la Tercera Bienal Internacional de Pintura, en Cuenca, Ecuador. Sus pinturas y dibujos forman parte de distinguidas colecciones institucionales y privadas. Integra sus preocupaciones ecológicas a la creación artística. Su obra puede enmarcarse entre la abstracción, la figuración y el expresionismo.
www.ceciarte.com
Cecilio Colón Guzmán
 (Barranquitas, P.R., 1959)
Painter. In 1976 started painting and drawing on a self-taught basis. In 1981 he obtained a Bachelor of Fine Arts with a major in Painting from the University of Puerto Rico, Río Piedras campus. He studied under the guidance of Carmelo Fontánez, Lope Max Díaz, Susana Herrero, Luis Hernández Cruz, and Luisa Géigel. He has exhibited his works, individually and collectively, in museums, galleries, and exhibition halls in Puerto Rico and abroad. In 1979 he received first prize in Young Art from the Royal Bank of Canada in Hato Rey, Puerto Rico. He has also received awards from the Ateneo Puertorriqueño, the University of Puerto Rico, and the Puerto Rico Association of Art Critics. In 1991 he participated in the Third International Biennial of Painting, in Cuenca, Ecuador. His paintings and drawings may be found in prominent institutional and private collections. He integrates his ecological concerns into his artistic creations. His work can be placed between abstraction, figuration, and expressionism.

inventory.description:
Ángel Guzmán
 (Utuado, PR, 1959)
Pintor, artista gráfico y dibujante. Obtiene un Bachillerato en Artes Gráficas de la Escuela de Artes Plásticas de Puerto Rico. Sus maestros fueron: Fran Cervoni, David Goitía, José Alicea y Julio Suárez. Participó en talleres de grabado como impresor junto a los artistas Antonio Martorell, María E. Somoza y Julio Suárez. En 1991 obtuvo el Primer Premio en Pintura y Mención de Honor en Grabado y Dibujo en el Certamen de Arte del Ateneo Puertorriqueño, en 1994 el Segundo Premio en Pintura de la Fundación Alfonso Arana, entre otros. En el 2001 fue artista invitado en la Muestra de Arte Nacional del Instituto de Cultura Puertorriqueña en San Juan. Trabaja la pintura al óleo, el grabado y actualmente, la escultura en madera. Sus obras tratan, en su mayoría, temas sociales.
Ángel Guzmán
 (Utuado, PR, 1959)
Painter, graphic artist and draftsman. He obtained a Bachelor of Arts in Graphic Arts from the Puerto Rico School of Visual Arts. His teachers were Fran Cervoni, David Goitía, José Alicea, and Julio Suárez. He has participated as a printer in engraving workshops with artists Antonio Martorell, María E. Somoza, and Julio Suárez. In 1991 he received First Prize in Painting and an Honorable Mention in Engraving and Drawing at the Ateneo Puertorriqueño’s Art Competition, and in 1994 Second Place in Painting from the Alfonso Arana Foundation, among others awards and recognitions. The Institute of Puerto Rican Culture selected him as guest artist for the National Art Exhibition in San Juan in 2001. He works in oil painting, engraving, and currently in wood sculpting. His works deal mostly with social issues.

Wilson Abreu
, (Constanza, Dominican Republic, 1972)

He has tought courses and seminars, among others, the seminar “African Cultures” at the Museum of Modern Art of the Dominican Republic.

 (San Juan, PR, 1956)
He learned the technique of serigraphy in a course he took at the Liga de Estudiantes de Arte de San Juan, with artist Antonio Martorell in 1973. He holds a Bachelor’s Degree in Biology from the University of Puerto Rico (1978), and graduated from the UPR School of Law (1983). He worked as a designer and printer of serigraphs, along with his sister, Magaly, at Taller Polilla in Santurce, Puerto Rico. inventory.name: Rafael Colón Morales – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Rafael Colón Morales
 (Trujillo Alto, P.R., 1941)
Pintor y profesor. Estudió el bachillerato en la Universidad de Puerto Rico, bajo la tutela de Félix Bonilla Norat; en American University en Washington, D.C. y en la Academia de Bellas Artes de San Fernando, Madrid. Desde 1970 reside en Nueva York. Ha sido profesor en la Universidad de Puerto Rico, en Brooklyn Community College, Nueva York y en la Escuela de Arte del Museo del Barrio. También ha participado como conferenciante de arte puertorriqueño en instituciones como Metropolitan Museum of Art, Cooper Union School of Science and the Arts y Stanford University. En 1984 fue nombrado Curador del Museo del Barrio de Nueva York. Se interesa por la experimentación de medios y técnicas, las que desarrolla con la aplicación de capas de polímeros acrílicos que luego sustrae para crear texturas y transparencias cromáticas en su obra. Su vocabulario expresivo se debate entre la figuración y la abstracción, además juega con la recreación de escenarios cargados de profundo misterio y de un intenso sentido metafísico.
Rafael Colón Morales
 (Trujillo Alto, P.R., 1941)
Painter and professor. His undergraduate studies took place at the University of Puerto Rico, under the guidance of Félix Bonilla Norat, at American University in Washington, D.C., and at the Academy of Fine Arts in San Fernando, Madrid. He has lived in New York since 1970. He has been a professor at the University of Puerto Rico, Brooklyn Community College, New York, and the School of Art of the Museo del Barrio. He has also lectured on Puerto Rican art at institutions such as the Metropolitan Museum of Art, Cooper Union School of Science and the Arts, and Stanford University. In 1984 he was appointed Curator of New York’s Museo del Barrio. He is interested in experimenting with mediums and techniques, which he develops by applying layers of acrylic polymers that he then removes to create textures and chromatic transparencies in his work. His expressive vocabulary fluctuates between figuration and abstraction, and he also plays with the recreation of scenery loaded with profound mystery and intense metaphysical meaning.

Redo del Olmo
 (Quebradillas, P.R., 1961)
Ceramista y profesor. En 1986 se graduó de la Universidad de Puerto Rico (UPR) con un Bachillerato en Artes Plásticas. Además ha tomado cursos de cerámica en porcelana en Nuevo México, la Liga de Arte de San Juan y en el taller de Toni Hambleton. Ha trabajado para el diseñador Harry Robles y actualmente se desempeña como profesor de cerámica en los Talleres de Bellos Oficios de la UPR. Su obra se ha presentado en Puerto Rico, Estados Unidos y Europa. Ha sido ganador del Primer Premio en la V Bienal Premio Casa Candina, San Juan, Puerto Rico, 1996, y el Premio Zebenik en la V Trienal Mundial de Cerámica en Pequeño Formato en Zagreb. En sus obras trabaja el tema de la piel relacionándolo con la esencia y la vida.
Redo del Olmo
 (Quebradillas, P.R., 1961)
Ceramist and teacher. In 1986 he graduated from the University of Puerto Rico (UPR) with a Bachelor of Fine Arts. He has also taken courses in porcelain ceramics in New Mexico, the Art League of San Juan and in Toni Hambleton’s workshop. He has worked for designer Harry Robles and currently works as a ceramics professor at the Talleres de Bellos Oficios of the UPR. His work has been presented in Puerto Rico, the United States and Europe. He has won the First Prize at the V Biennial Casa Candina Prize, San Juan, Puerto Rico, 1996, and the Zebenik Prize at the V World Triennial of Small Format Ceramics in Zagreb. In his works he works on the theme of skin, relating it to essence and life.

inventory.description:
Artista y músico. Estudia dibujo en el Instituto de Santa Cruz de Tenerife y música en el Conservatorio de la misma ciudad, donde se convierte en violinista de la Orquesta Sinfónica tinerfeña y de la Orquesta de Cámara del Círculo de Bellas Artes. En 1942 se establece en Madrid y luego, en 1950 se muda a Puerto Rico, donde trabajó como dibujante y director en periódico El Imparcial y como professor de dibujo en varios colegios y academias. En Puerto Rico, además Funda la academia de pintura Sureda. Más tarde se muda a Miami, Florida donde vivió hasta el final de su vida.
www.sureda.org/Xtras/GSA/Sala_Museo_Sur…
Guillermo Sureda Arbelo (1912 Arucas, Canary Islands – 2006 Miami, USA)
Artist and musician. He studied drawing at the Institute of Santa Cruz de Tenerife and music at the Conservatory of the same city, where he became a violinist of the Tenerife Symphony Orchestra and the Chamber Orchestra of the Círculo de Bellas Artes. In 1942 he settled in Madrid and then in 1950 he moved to Puerto Rico, where he worked as a draftsman and director of the newspaper El Imparcial and as a drawing teacher in several schools and academies. In Puerto Rico, he also founded the Sureda painting academy. Later he moved to Miami, Florida where he lived until the end of his life.

inventory.name: Ricardo Ramírez – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Ricardo Ramírez
 (San Juan, PR, 1958)
Pintor. Realizó sus estudios en State University of New York College en 1982. En 1996 tuvo la oportunidad de viajar a París becado por la Fundación Alfonso Arana, suceso que dio comienzo a una proyección internacional en su carrera. En el 1998 y el 2000 tuvo la oportunidad de participar en la exposición llamada “Salón de otoño” de la ciudad de París. En el 2000 participó en la exposición de arte puertorriqueño de la UNESCO, y en este mismo año se hizo parte de la Sociedad Nacional de Bellas Artes de Francia, de la cual es el único miembro puertorriqueño, participando así en una colectiva en el Museo del Louvre. Su estilo expresionista se ve nutrido por las escuelas de este genero de Nueva York y Paris, así como de la escuela española, sin descuidar los fuertes colores del Caribe.
Ricardo Ramírez (San Juan, PR, 1958)
Painter. He studied at the State University of New York College in 1982. In 1996 he had the opportunity to travel to Paris with a scholarship from the Alfonso Arana Foundation, an event that began an international projection in his career. In 1998 and 2000 he had the opportunity to participate in the exhibition called “Salon d’Automne” in Paris. In 2000 he participated in the exhibition of Puerto Rican art of UNESCO, and in the same year he became part of the National Society of Fine Arts of France, of which he is the only Puerto Rican member, participating in a group exhibition at the Louvre Museum. His expressionist style is nourished by the schools of this genre of New York and Paris, as well as the Spanish school, without neglecting the strong colors of the Caribbean.

inventory.name: Gerardo Torres – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Gerardo Torres
 (Ponce, PR, 1964)
Pintor, dibujante y escultor. Estudió en la Escuela de Arte Miguel Pou de Ponce, con Diógenes Ballester. En 1989 hizo un Bachillerato en Artes Plásticas con concentración en Pintura en la Escuela de Artes Plásticas de Puerto Rico. Durante sus estudios asistió a un taller de dibujo con Alfonso Arana y participó como estudiante orientador en un taller de grabado. En la década de los noventa trabajó como ilustrador en un proyecto arqueológico en Ballajá. Ha presentado su obra desde 1981 tanto individual como colectivamente. Ha recibido premios y reconocimientos tales como: Primer Premio en Gráfica, Academia de Artes y Ciencias del Museo de Arte e Historia de San Juan (1988); Primer Premio en Pintura y Mención de Honor en Grabado, Escuela de Artes Plásticas de Puerto Rico (1989) y Segundo Premio en Pintura y Medalla Plástica Latina, Fundación Alfonso Arana, Puerto Rico (1991), entre otros. Trabaja el óleo en imágenes hiperrealistas.
Gerardo Torres
 (Ponce, PR, 1964)
Painter, draftsman, and sculptor. He studied with Diógenes Ballester at the Miguel Pou School of Art in Ponce. In 1989 he completed a Bachelor of Arts in Visual Arts with a major in Painting from the Puerto Rico School of Plastic Arts. As a student he attended a drawing workshop with Alfonso Arana and was a student counselor in an engraving workshop. During the nineties he worked as illustrator in an archeological project in Ballajá. Since 1981 he has exhibited his work individually and collectively. He has received several awards and recognitions, such as: First Prize in Graphics from the Academy of Arts and Sciences of the San Juan Art and History Museum (1988); First Prize in Painting and Honorable Mention in Engraving from the Puerto Rico School of Visual Arts (1989); and Second Prize in Painting and Latin Plastic Arts Medal from the Alfonso Arana Foundation in Puerto Rico (1991), among others. He works hyperrealist images in oil.

inventory.name: Olga Albizu – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Olga Albizu
 (Ponce, P.R., 1924 – Nueva York, EEUU, 2005)
Pintora. Estudió dibujo con Miguel Pou y pintura en la Universidad de Puerto Rico (UPR) con el español Esteban Vicente. En 1948 fue becada por la UPR para estudiar en Nueva York con el pintor alemán Hans Hofmann. Su estancia en Nueva York le permitió tener contacto con grandes figuras de la abstracción como Morris Kantor, Carl Holty y Vaclav Vytlacil en la Liga de Estudiantes de Arte de Nueva York. En 1951 asistió a la Académie de la Grande Chaumière en París y al año siguiente a la Academia de Bellas Artes de Florencia. En 1956 sus pinturas comenzaron a figurar en las carátulas de los discos de bossa nova producidos por RCA y Verve Records. En 1958 se estableció permanentemente en la ciudad de Nueva York, mismo año en que se organizó su primera exposición individual en Puerto Rico. Tras una larga trayectoria de producción deja de pintar en 1984. Se le considera pionera del expresionismo abstracto en el arte puertorriqueño. Algunos se han referido a su abstraccionismo como uno de carácter lírico.
Olga Albizu
 (Ponce, P.R., 1924 – New York, US, 2005)
Painter. Studied drawing under Miguel Pou and painting at the University of Puerto Rico (UPR) under Spaniard Esteban Vicente. In 1948 she received a scholarship from the UPR to study in New York under German painter Hans Hofmann. Her stay in New York allowed her to come into contact with some of the great abstract artists, such as Morris Kantor, Carl Holty, and Vaclav Vytlacil at the New York League of Art Students. In 1951 she attended the Académie de la Grande Chaumière in Paris, and the following year the Fine Arts Academy of Florence. In 1956 her paintings began appearing on the covers of bossa nova records produced by RCA and Verve Records. In 1958 she established herself permanently in New York City and organized her first individual exhibition in Puerto Rico. After a long and productive trajectory, she stopped painting in 1984. She is considered a pioneer of abstract expressionism in Puerto Rican art. Her abstractionism has been described by some as possessing a lyrical character.

inventory.name: Susana Espinosa – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Susana Espinosa
 (Buenos Aires, Argentina, 1933 – San Juan, Puerto Rico, 2022)
Ceramista y dibujante. Obtuvo su bachillerato en la Academia de Bellas Artes de Buenos Aires en 1953. Trabajó en una fábrica de cerámica hasta abrir su propio taller en 1958. Vivió varios años en Trinidad, luego en 1968, se estableció en Puerto Rico y comenzó a trabajar con Hal Lasky, hasta abrir un taller con Bernardo Hogan e Isabel Rivera. Desde 1989 pertenece a la Academia Internacional de la Cerámica y su obra ha ganado premios internacionales. Desde la década del setenta ha recibido un sinnúmero de comisiones para murales cerámicos alrededor de Puerto Rico; uno de los más conocidos es el de la destilería Bacardí. En 1977 se unió al grupo 
Manos
 y en 1980 fundó, junto a Bernardo Hogan, Toni Hambleton y Jaime Suárez, 
Casa Candina
, donde amplió su obra e impartió clases de cerámica. En el 2003 fue seleccionada para realizar su 
Torre Mural
 como parte del Proyecto de Arte Público de Puerto Rico.
Susana Espinosa
 (Buenos Aires, Argentina, 1933 – San Juan, Puerto Rico, 2022)
Ceramist and draftsman. She obtained her Bachelor of Arts from the Academy of Fine Arts in Buenos Aires in 1953. She worked at a ceramics manufacturing plant until she opened her own workshop in 1958. She lived for several years in Trinidad, then moved to Puerto Rico in 1968 and began working with Hal Lasky, until she opened a workshop with Bernardo Hogan and Isabel Rivera. She has been a member of the International Academy of Ceramics since 1989 and her work has received several international awards. Since the seventies she has been commissioned on countless occasions to design ceramic murals in different parts of Puerto Rico; one of the most well-known is the one at the Bacardi Distillery. In 1977, she joined the 
Manos
 (Hands) group and in 1980 she founded 
Casa Candina
 with Bernardo Hogan, Toni Hambleton, and Jaime Suarez, where she expanded her work and taught ceramics classes. In 2003, she was selected to create her 
Torre Mural
 (Mural Tower) as part of the Puerto Rico Public Art Project.

Lizette Lugo
 (San Juan, PR, 1956)
Artista gráfica, dibujante y pintora. Estudia su Bachillerato en Artes Visuales en la Universidad del Sagrado Corazón en Santurce y en la Liga de Estudiantes de Arte de San Juan, donde se le otorga una beca de estudios. De 1994 a 1999 establece su propia galería, Sala de Arte, en el Viejo San Juan. Ha sido reconocida internacionalmente por su trabajo serigráfico. Ha exhibido individualmente en Puerto Rico, Estados Unidos y Venezuela. Ha participado en muestras colectivas en Polonia, Noruega, España, Estados Unidos, Venezuela, Colombia, República Dominicana y Francia. Ha representado a Puerto Rico en bienales y trienales de grabado. Su obra se encuentra en numerosas colecciones públicas y privadas.
Lizette Lugo
 (San Juan, PR, 1956)
Graphic artist, draftswoman, and painter. She coursed undergraduate studies in Visual Arts at Sacred Heart University in Santurce and the Art Students’ League of San Juan, which she attended on a scholarship. From 1994 to 1999 she had her own gallery, Sala de Arte, in Old San Juan. She is internationally known for her work in serigraphy. She has held individual exhibitions in Puerto Rico, the United States, and Venezuela, and has also participated in collective exhibitions in Poland, Norway, Spain, the United States, Venezuela, Colombia, the Dominican Republic, and France. She has represented Puerto Rico at engraving biennials and triennials. Her work is found in numerous public and private collections.

Artista gráfico. Estudió en la Escuela de Artes Plásticas de Puerto Rico donde obtuvo un Bachillerato en Artes Plásticas con concentración en Gráfica en 1992. Artista multidisciplinario ha trabajado la gráfica, el video, los medios mixtos y las publicaciones. Ha participado en varias exposiciones colectivas e individuales entre las que se destacan: 
Re-cuento

Paisaje interno (1998)
. Fue premiado por el Programa de Subvención Básica para las Artes y el Fondo Nacional para el Quehacer Cultural en 1996 y 1994.
Javier Martínez
 (Caguas, PR, 1968)
Graphic artist. He studied at the Escuela de Artes Plásticas de Puerto Rico where he obtained a Bachelor of Fine Arts with a concentration in Graphics in 1992. Multidisciplinary artist has worked with graphics, video, mixed media and publications. He has participated in several group and solo exhibitions among which stand out: Re-cuento (2006), a solo exhibition in which he worked on the theme of the media and the mass reaction to it; Obras recientes (2002) and Paisaje interno (1998). He was awarded by the Basic Grant Program for the Arts and the National Fund for Cultural Activities in 1996 and 1994.

inventory.name: Rafael Claudio – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Rafael Claudio
Cursó estudios en la Universidad de Puerto Rico y en el prestigioso Fashion Institute of Technology de la ciudad de Nueva York. Comenzó su carrera en los años 80 en el campo publicitario, trabajando como escenográfo para la televisión en Puerto Rico, Estado Unidos y México. Ha hecho innumerables fotos de artistas de nivel internacional. Ha participado en varias exposiciones las que destacan Carnevale di Venecia (1986), representación pictórica del legendario Carnaval de Venecia; Semana Santa en Sevilla (1992), una muestra del fervor del pueblo español durante la Semana Santa; Fuera de Foco (1996), una visión peculiar de diferentes figuras del ambiente artístico puertorriqueño; y Carne Cruda (1999), una muestra del desnudo masculino como expresión artística.
Rafael Claudio
Studied at the University of Puerto Rico and at the prestigious Fashion Institute of Technology in New York City. Began his career in the 80’s in the advertising field, working as a set designer for television in Puerto Rico, the United States and Mexico. He has taken countless photos of international artists. He has participated in several exhibitions including Carnevale di Venecia (1986), a pictorial representation of the legendary Venice Carnival; Semana Santa en Sevilla (1992), a sample of the fervor of the Spanish people during Holy Week; Fuera de Foco (1996), a peculiar vision of different figures of the Puerto Rican artistic environment; and Carne Cruda (1999), a sample of the male nude as an artistic expression.

inventory.name: Carlos Mercado – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Carlos Mercado
 (Ponce, PR, 1958)
Pintor, empresario y diseñador de muebles, ambientaciones y arreglos florales. Artista autodidacta. Obtuvo un Bachillerato en Artes y Ciencias de la Universidad Católica de Ponce, Puerto Rico. Ha exhibido en Puerto Rico y Estados Unidos en más de una docena de muestras colectivas e individuales desde 1989. Se considera así mismo como un artista conceptual más que un pintor o diseñador. Está influenciado por el arte pop y experimental. Su obra temprana constaba de impresiones de su propio cuerpo en la tela, las cuales lograba manchándose completamente de pintura; luego trabajó con los medios mixtos y el collage para más tarde adentrarse al mundo de la abstracción. En la onda pop ha trabajado retratos en los cuales captura la esencia y los sentimientos de quien pinta. Desde el 2001 es el dueño y creador de Verbena, un espacio que fusiona el arte de crear con la naturaleza, además de plasmarla en el lienzo.
Carlos Mercado,
 (Ponce, PR, 1958)
Painter, businessman and designer of furniture, atmospheres, and floral arrangements. Self-taught artist. He obtained a Bachelor of Arts and Sciences from the Catholic University in Ponce, Puerto Rico. He has participated in more than a dozen collective and individual exhibitions in Puerto Rico and the United States since 1989. He considers himself a conceptual artist more than a painter or designer. He is influenced by pop and experimental art. His early works contained impressions of his own body on cloth, which he attained by drenching himself entirely in paint. He later worked with mixed media and collages, immersing himself in the abstract world. Within pop style he has worked on portraits that capture the essence and feelings of the model. Since 2001 he has been the owner and creator of Verbena, a space that merges the art of creating with nature, in addition to capturing it on the canvas.

inventory.name: The Storehouse Group – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
The Storehouse Group
Nace a finales del 2006 y surge de la inquietud del artista Gamaliel Rodríguez-Ayala. Al regresar a Isla luego de cursar estudios de maestría en Inglaterra, Gamaliel se percata de la falta de galerías en Puerto Rico que estuviesen comprometidas con difundir la obra contemporánea de artistas emergentes en el extranjero. Es por ello que hace el acercamiento a varios artistas plásticos de la escena local como Rogelio Báez-Vega y Efrén Candelaria y al galerista Guillermo Rodríguez para que éste estuviera a la cabeza de este proyecto.
Con un elenco inicial de cuatro artistas, Gamaliel Rodríguez, María Jähr, Rogelio Báez Vega y Efrén Candelaria, el colectivo emprende una vertiginosa y prolífica serie de exhibiciones y presentaciones en ferias internacionales como: Art L.A. ‘07, Scope NY ’07, Scope Basel ’07 entre otras, al igual que el 14 Trienal del Grabado en Tallinn, Estonia. En menos de año y medio de vida, el proyecto/galería The Storehouse Group y sus artistas han gozado de innumerables reconocimientos, tanto en la vena local y la escena internacional del arte contemporáneo.  Este grupo ha ido evolucionando y definiendo  el papel que desea tomar en la escena local e internacional. Un proceso de mucho sacrificio y dedicación les ha permitido escalar peldaño a peldaño la escalera del éxito y el reconocimiento.
The Storehouse Group
Conceived in November 2006 by  artist Gamaliel Rodriguez on his return to Puerto Rico from England. Having culminated his M.A. degree in Arts, Gamaliel noticed the existent void in the Puerto Rican Art scene of a committed venue that would push and disseminate the work of emerging artists Puerto Rican to the world. It is the awareness of this existing reality what pushes him to approach some of his fellow artists and friends, Rogelio Báez-Vega and Efrén Candelaria, together with the well known gallerist Guillermo Rodríguez to direct and materialize this endeavor.
Starting with four members, Gamaliel Rodríguez, Maria Jahr, Rogelio Báez-Vega and Efrén Candelaria, the project embarked itself into an explosive and prolific series of exhibitions and presentations throughout 2007. Among these were Art L.A. ‘07, Scope New York ’07, Scope Basel ’07 and the 14th Tallinn Print Triennial in Estonia. In less than a year and half of the existence of this gallery/project, its members received recognition, invitations and a great deal of attention from the art scene in Puerto Rico, as well as the international venues. The Storehouse Group is committed to achieving the goals founder artist Gamaliel Rodríguez had envisioned.The group had its headquarters in San Juan, Puerto Rico and stopped its operations in 2010.

inventory.name: Amber Lia Kloppel – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Amber Lia-Kloppel was born in Ithaca, New York and she studied art as a young adult at the Community School of Music and Arts. She did her undergraduate study in Philadelphia at Moore College of Art and Design, receiving a BFA, and subsequently moved to New York City where she received her MFA from the New York Academy of Art. Amber has been awarded the Elizabeth Greenshields Foundation Grant, the Constance Saltonstall Foundation Grant, and the Stobart Foundation Grant for her work. During graduate school she was awarded a Prince of Wales/Forbes Foundation Travel Grant and Residency, and during undergraduate school she received the Emily Sartain Fellowship for European Travel. She has studied with renowned figurative artists and teachers including Steven Assael, Moe Brooker, Patrick Connors, Will Cotton, Vincent Desiderio, Tina Newberry, Ted Schmidt, Wade Schuman, and Steve Sherman, among others.
She paints mostly figurative compositions and portraits, and her work is grounded in American and Dutch traditions of genre painting. Her major influences range from Johannes Vermeer to Edward Hopper to Alice Neel, and while there is a tendency towards voyeurism in her work, it is countered by an element of confrontation. Amber’s work has been shown primarily in New York, Philadelphia, and San Juan, Puerto Rico, and it is part of numerous private collections including HRH the Prince of Wales, and the Emmy Award winning actor Martin Short. Her work is included in the permanent collections of the Palmer Museum of Art, and in the CIGNA Museum and Art Collection. Amber currently lives and works in Ithaca, NY.
www.amberlia-kloppel.com

inventory.name: Robert Rocca – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Robert Rocca
 (Saint-Fons, France 1927)
Born in 1927, Robert Rocca was largely influenced by the 1930s growing up. Internationally this period can be best characterised by the conflict between the world’s foremost political philosophies – Marxist Socialism, Capitalist Democracy, and the Totalitarianism of both Communism and Fascism. In the United States, the Great Depression had a tremendous impact on artistic output, with a number of artists taking inspiration from the agrarian and the humble man in the streets. It was the first time in US history that widespread collectives of artists began to address politics, and attempted to use their art to influence society. Artists focused exhibitions on social and political themes such as poverty, lack of affordable housing, anti-lynching, anti-fascism, and workers’ strikes. In Europe, Surrealism continued to be the leading artistic trend; a kind of expression and school of thought that by this time had spread worldwide. In Mexico, artists such as Frida Kahlo and Diego Rivera incorporated many of these philosophies into their radical political ideologies to develop a new kind of magic realism. In the Soviet Union, Stalin’s government required urgent funds to implement the rapid industrialisation demanded by the first Five Year Plan. It initiated a secret proposal to sell off treasures from the State Hermitage Museum in Leningrad (St. Petersburg), including a primary list of two hundred and fifty irreplaceable paintings by the Old Masters, many of which found their way to the collection of Andrew Mellon via the New York based art dealing company, Knoedler. The era assumed a sinister turn with the dawn of National Socialism in Germany, and Adolf Hitler’s rise to power in 1933. The decade would conclude in the inset on the Second World War; a political and social furore that preoccupied not only artists, but great swathes of the world’s population.
www.artland.com/artists/robert-rocca

Adriana Mangual
 (Nueva York, EEUE, 1945)
Ceramista. Estudió pintura, dibujo y escultura en la Escuela de Artes Plásticas de San Juan y cerámica en Casa Candina. Obtuvo el Primer Premio en la Primera Bienal de la Cerámica Contemporánea Puertorriqueña en San Juan y Mención Honorífica en la Segunda y Tercera Bienal. Trabaja con la ingenuidad de la niña y crea una imaginería original, ingeniosa y refrescante. Su obra ha sido expuesta en Puerto Rico, Alemania, Estados Unidos y Japón.
Adriana Mangual
 (New York, US, 1945)
Ceramist. She studied painting, drawing, and sculpture at the San Juan School of Visual Arts and ceramics at Casa Candina. She won First Prize at the First Biennial on Contemporary Puerto Rican Ceramics in San Juan, and Honorable Mentions at the Second and Third Biennials. She works with a child-like ingenuousness and creates an original, ingenious, and refreshing imagery. Her work has been shown in Puerto Rico, Germany, the United States, and Japan.

inventory.name: Victoria Gitman – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Victoria Gitman
 (Buenos Aires, Argentina, 1974)
Born in Buenos Aires, Argentina in 1972, Victoria Gitman immigrated to the United States in 1987. In 1996, she graduated from Florida International University with a BFA in Painting and a BA in Humanities. She was also a fellow at the Yale Summer School of Art.
Victoria Gitman’s work intertwines the experiences of vision and touch, exploring the tactile pull inherent to painting and the circuits of desire it generates. Beginning in the early 2000s with her representations of vintage costume jewelry and beaded purses, and continuing with her current series depicting fur handbags, the artist has focused on the seductive material textures of these objects. The works create an alignment between the purses and the picture plane, pointing to the implicit identification of the painting’s surface as feminine and bringing to the fore the traditionally gendered structure of the painting-viewer relationship.
Gitman’s subjects are sourced from flea markets, vintage stores, and secondhand shops online. Painted bead by bead and hair by hair, the objects are limned in actual scale from close, direct observation. With their fine facture and intimate scale, Gitman’s paintings elicit very close viewing, an almost touching with the eyes. The distance between beholder and picture plane is narrowed to the smallest of measures and the condensed space between them, charged with a palpable desire, becomes part of the work. The close, slow interaction that results between viewer and painting, the almost contact between them, thus emerges as an integral element of her work.
Victoria Gitman’s paintings and drawings are held in the collections of many museums, including the Los Angeles County Museum of Art; the Museum of Modern Art, New York; the Whitney Museum of American Art; the Detroit Institute of Arts; the Museum of Contemporary Art San Diego; the Pérez Art Museum Miami; and the Columbus Museum of Art, among others.
Solo exhibitions of her work have been held at Daniel Weinberg Gallery (2004, 2006, 2009, Los Angeles), David Nolan Gallery (2006, 2011, New York), Tomio Koyama Gallery (2014, Tokyo), and Garth Greenan Gallery (2015, 2018, New York). In 2005, the Bass Museum, Miami mounted On Display, Gitman’s first museum exhibition. Three years later, Looking Closely, a solo exhibition of her paintings and drawings, opened at the Las Vegas Art Museum. In 2015, the Pérez Art Museum Miami presented Victoria Gitman: Desiring Eye, a mid-career survey of her work.
Victoria Gitman is represented by Garth Greenan Gallery, New York.

inventory.name: Consuelo Gotay – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Consuelo Gotay
 (Bayamón, PR, 1949)
Artista gráfica, diseñadora y profesora. Se graduó de la Universidad de Puerto Rico en la década del setenta para luego realizar su maestría en la Universidad de Columbia en Nueva York. Ingresó como aprendiz de grabado en el Taller de Gráfica de la Escuela de Arquitectura, con José A. Torres Martino como maestro y posteriormente en el taller de Lorenzo Homar. También realizó estudios de impresión en la Escuela Vocacional Bernardino Cordero Bernard de Ponce y en Center for Book Arts en Nueva York. Estudió grabado no tóxico con Keith Howard en Canadá. Fue Directora del Taller de Gráfica de la Escuela de Arquitectura de la Universidad de Puerto Rico. Ha ejercido como profesora en Puerto Rico y República Dominicana. Su obra ha merecido premios y menciones a lo largo de su notable carrera. Domina la xilografía, el linóleo, el diseño de letras y la serigrafía. Ha creado portafolios y libros de artistas que unen imagen, diseño y palabra. Su obra en grabado plantea elaboraciones poéticas del paisaje nativo utilizando texturas de trazo elegante.
Consuelo Gotay
 (Bayamón, PR, 1949)
Graphic artist, designer and professor. She graduated from the University of Puerto Rico in the seventies and pursued a Master’s degree at Columbia University in New York. She joined the Graphics Workshop of the School of Architecture as an engraving apprentice under professor José A. Torres Martinó and later trained at the Lorenzo Homar studio. She also studied printing at the Bernardino Cordero Bernard Vocational School in Ponce and at the Center for Book Arts in New York. She trained in non-toxic engraving with Keith Howard in Canada. She directed the School of Architecture’s Graphics Workshop at the University of Puerto Rico. She has taught in Puerto Rico and the Dominican Republic. Her work has received numerous awards and recognitions throughout her distinguished career. She has full command of xylography, linoleum, letter design, and serigraphy, and has created artists’ portfolios and books that merge image, design, and the written word. Her engraving work poses poetic elaborations from the native landscape by using textures created with elegant strokes.

inventory.name: Noín Rivera – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Noín Rivera
 (Arecibo, PR, 1966)
A la edad de 16 años comenzó a tomar cursos en arte en la Escuela Superior Pablo Ávila en Camuy con el maestro y artista Rafael Velázquez. Luego prosiguió sus estudios de arte en forma privada con el artista Roland Borges Soto, en su Academia de Arte. Allí perfeccionó sus conocimientos en la teoría del color y perspectiva. En el 1987, se trasladó a Ponce, donde terminó su Bachillerato en Biología, tomando además cursos de arte.
Fue maestro en la Academia y Centro de Arte en Arecibo y en Casa Ulanga en el mismo municipio. Perteneció a Plástica Latina de Puerto Rico. Fue artista invitado de la Universidad de Puerto Rico, Recinto de Arecibo en el Taller Arte a la Vista dirigido por la artista Ilka Esteva.
En 1993 comenzó estudios formales en la Escuela de Artes Plásticas en San Juan, Puerto Rico; donde estudió pintura y grabado. Para esa misma época fue maestro de arte en el Hogar Colegio La Milagrosa. Durante los años de 1997 al 2000 fue maestro de arte en el Colegio Nuestra Señora del Rosario en el municipio de Vega Baja. De aquí pasó a la Universidad Interamericana de Puerto Rico, Recinto de San Germán, para estudiar su grado de Maestría en Bellas Artes con concentración en Pintura, el cual culminó en el año 2002. Fue profesor en el Departamento de Arte del mismo Recinto de San Germán del 2001 al 2003. En el año 2004 viajó a Altos del Chavón en la República Dominicana para tomar cursos de Figura Humana. Actualmente es profesor en los Departamentos de Humanidades de la Universidad de Puerto Rico, y de la Universidad Interamericana, Recintos de Arecibo.
Fuente
Noín Rivera (Arecibo, PR, 1966)
At the age of 16 she began taking art courses at the Escuela Superior Pablo Avila in Camuy with the teacher and artist Rafael Velázquez. She then continued his art studies privately with artist Roland Borges Soto at his Art Academy. There she perfected her knowledge of color theory and perspective. In 1987, she moved to Ponce, where she finished his Bachelor’s degree in Biology, also taking art courses.
She taught at the Academia y Centro de Arte in Arecibo and at Casa Ulanga in the same municipality. She belonged to Plástica Latina de Puerto Rico. She was a guest artist at the University of Puerto Rico, Arecibo Campus in the workshop Arte a la Vista directed by artist Ilka Esteva.
In 1993 she began formal studies at the Escuela de Artes Plásticas in San Juan, Puerto Rico; where she studied painting and printmaking. At the same time she was an art teacher at the Hogar Colegio La Milagrosa. From 1997 to 2000 she was an art teacher at Colegio Nuestra Señora del Rosario in the municipality of Vega Baja. From there she went to the Interamerican University of Puerto Rico, San Germán Campus, to study her Master’s degree in Fine Arts with a concentration in Painting, which she completed in 2002. She was a professor in the Art Department of the same San Germán Campus from 2001 to 2003. In 2004 she traveled to Altos del Chavón in the Dominican Republic to take courses in Human Figure. She is currently a professor in the Humanities Departments of the University of Puerto Rico and the Interamerican University, Arecibo Campus.

inventory.description:
Nono Rivera
 (San Juan, PR, 1949)
Pintor y artista gráfico. De formación autodidacta y tras una década desempeñándose como impresor serigráfico, desarrolla su obra personal a partir de 1987. A finales del 1994, inauguró la galería Sala de Arte. En 1997 se le otorgó Mención de Honor en Pintura en el Tercer Certamen de Pintura y Dibujo de la Fundación Alfonso Arana. Ha presentado su obra tanto individual como colectivamente dentro y fuera de Puerto Rico.
Nono Rivera (San Juan, PR, 1949)
Painter and graphic artist. Self-taught and after a decade working as a silkscreen printer, he developed his personal work in 1987. At the end of 1994, he opened the Sala de Arte gallery. In 1997 he was awarded Honorable Mention in Painting in the Third Alfonso Arana Foundation Painting and Drawing Contest. He has presented his work both individually and collectively in Puerto Rico and abroad.

inventory.name: Carlos Marcial – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Carlos Marcial
 (Caguas, PR, 1954)
Pintor. Cursó su Maestría en Artes Visuales en la Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM). En 1985 ejerció como profesor de dibujo de la Escuela de Artes Plásticas de San Juan. En 1988 fue Director del Taller de Restauración de Ornamentos Arquitectónicos de la Antigua Escuela de Medicina Tropical de San Juan y, simultáneamente y hasta el 1990, fungió como profesor de Historia del Arte, Acuarela, Teoría del color, Pintura y Dibujo de la Universidad Interamericana Recinto Metropolitano. Desde 1990 a 1994 se desempeñó como profesor de pintura y dibujo experimental, diseño y dibujo básico de la Escuela de Artes Plásticas de San Juan. Un año más tarde trabajó como Director del Departamento de Pintura de la Escuela de Artes Plásticas de San Juan. Su trabajo se ha exhibido en Puerto Rico, México, Cuba, Francia, España, Estados Unidos y Guadalupe.
Carlos Marcial
 (Caguas, PR, 1954)
Painter. He studied for his Master of Arts in Visual Arts at the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM). In 1985 he worked as a drawing professor at the San Juan School of Visual Arts. In 1988, he was Director of the Workshop on Restoration of Architectural Ornaments of the Old School of Tropical Medicine in San Juan and, simultaneously and until 1990, was professor of Art History, Watercolor, Theory of Color, Painting, and Drawing at the Metropolitan campus of the Inter American University. From 1990 to 1994 he taught experimental painting and drawing, design, and basic drawing at the San Juan School of Visual Arts, and the following year became Director of its Painting Department. His work has been shown in Puerto Rico, Mexico, Cuba, France, Spain, the United States, and Guadeloupe.

inventory.name: Yelyn Vivoni – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Yelyn Vivoni
 (San Juan, PR, 1954)
Ceramista. Estudió Artes Plásticas en el Colegio de Mayagüez y aprendió el arte de la cerámica bajo la tutela del maestro Jerry Saint Germain. En los últimos años comparte taller con el pintor y escultor Luis Ivorra donde continuamente desarrolla su quehacer artístico. Ha exhibido su obra desde el 2001 en distintas galerías y museos de Puerto Rico y en el 2003 participó de una colectiva en una galería en Pennsylvania. En Europa, recientemente participó en la VIII Bienal Internacional de Cerámica, Manises, Valencia, España y además en la Biennale Internazionale dell’Arte Contemporanea, Florencia, Italia, donde ganó la Medalla del 5to lugar en la categoría de Medio Mixto.
Describe su trabajo como “funcional”, ya que mucho de él se basa en la creación de vasijas, platos de centros de mesa y tapices. Sus obras contienen un elemento de nostalgia y naturaleza; se destacan por sus colores, los que logra con la combinación de distintas proporciones de una variedad de minerales en polvo, tras aplicar primero una capa de óxido de cobre.
Yelyn Vivoni
 (San Juan, PR, 1954)
Ceramist. She studied Plastic Arts at the Colegio de Mayagüez and learned the art of ceramics under the tutelage of master artist Jerry Saint Germain. In recent years he shares a workshop with painter and sculptor Luis Ivorra where he continuously develops his artistic work. He has exhibited his work since 2001 in various galleries and museums in Puerto Rico and in 2003 he participated in a group exhibition in a gallery in Pennsylvania. In Europe, he recently participated in the VIII International Biennial of Ceramics, Manises, Valencia, Spain and also in the Biennale Internazionale dell’Arte Contemporanea, Florence, Italy, where he won the 5th place Medal in the category of Mixed Media.
She describes his work as “functional”, as much of it is based on the creation of vessels, centerpiece plates and tapestries. His works contain an element of nostalgia and nature; they stand out for their colors, which he achieves by combining different proportions of a variety of powdered minerals, after first applying a layer of copper oxide.

inventory.name: Oliverio Hinojosa – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Oliverio Hinojosa
 (Nueva Rosita, Coahuila, México, 1953- 2001)
Pintor. De 1971 a 1975 estudió una Licenciatura en Humanidades con especialización en Artes Plásticas en la Universidad de Puerto Rico y durante estos años, en 1974, fue becario del Pratt Graphic Center de Nueva York. En 1978 obtuvo la Maestría en Artes Plásticas en la Escuela Nacional de Artes Plásticas (Academia San Carlos), UNAM, México, D.F. Su obra se ha presentado en Estados Unidos, Latinoamérica, Europa y el Caribe. Ganó varios premios y distinciones entre los que se encuentran: Primer Premio, Primer Encuentro Nacional de Arte Joven; Primer Premio Salón Nacional de Artes Plásticas, Sección de Experimentación, Grupo Suma, INBA, México, D.F. y Primer Premio, Primer Encuentro Nacional de Arte Joven, Casa de la Cultura Aguascalientes, México. Su obra se relaciona con su entorno y sus vivencias utilizando la figura humana como aspecto principal para definir el hombre actual.
Oliverio Hinojosa
 (Nueva Rosita, Coahuila, Mexico, 1953- 2001)
Painter. From 1971 to 1975 he studied a Bachelor’s Degree in Humanities with a major in Plastic Arts at the University of Puerto Rico and during these years, in 1974, he was a scholar at the Pratt Graphic Center in New York. In 1978 he obtained a Master’s Degree in Fine Arts at the Escuela Nacional de Artes Plásticas (Academia San Carlos), UNAM, Mexico City. His work has been presented in the United States, Latin America, Europe and the Caribbean. He won several awards and distinctions among which are: First Prize, First National Encounter of Young Art; First Prize National Salon of Plastic Arts, Experimentation Section, Grupo Suma, INBA, Mexico, D.F. and First Prize, First National Encounter of Young Art, Casa de la Cultura Aguascalientes, Mexico. His work is related to his environment and his experiences using the human figure as the main aspect to define the current man.

inventory.name: Omar Velázquez – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Omar Velázquez
 (Isabela, PR, 1984)
Grabador, pintor y creador de instalaciones. En el 2008 obtuvo un Bachillerato en Bellas Artes con concentración en Grabado de la Universidad de Puerto Rico, Recinto de Río Piedras. Posteriormente completa una Maestría en Pintura y Dibujo en The School of the Art Institute en Chicago. Recibió en dos ocasiones la Primera Mención de Honor en el Primer Certamen de Arte Joven de Oriental Group (2008 y 2010) y la Beca Lexus en el año 2013. Ha participado en exhibiciones individuales y colectivas en países como Japón, República de Macedonia, Estados Unidos, México y Colombia. Su obra se encuentra en importantes colecciones como el Museo de Arte Contemporáneo de Puerto Rico, Museo de Historia, Antropología y Arte, Universidad de Puerto Rico, Recinto de Río Piedras, Museo de Arte Dr. Pío López Martínez, Universidad de Puerto Rico, Recinto de Cayey y el Museo de Arte de Puerto Rico.
Omar Velázquez (Isabela, PR, 1984)
Engraver, painter and creator of installations. In 2008 he obtained a Bachelor of Fine Arts with a concentration in Printmaking from the University of Puerto Rico, Rio Piedras Campus. He later completed a Master’s Degree in Painting and Drawing at The School of the Art Institute in Chicago. He received twice the First Honorable Mention in the First Young Art Contest of Oriental Group (2008 and 2010) and the Lexus Scholarship in 2013. He has participated in solo and group exhibitions in countries such as Japan, Republic of Macedonia, United States, Mexico and Colombia. His work can be found in important collections such as the Museo de Arte Contemporáneo de Puerto Rico, Museo de Historia, Antropología y Arte, University of Puerto Rico, Río Piedras Campus, Museo de Arte Dr. Pío López Martínez, University of Puerto Rico, Cayey Campus and the Museo de Arte de Puerto Rico.

inventory.name: Jacob Charles Morales Marchosky – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Jacob Charles Morales Marchosky
 (San Juan, PR, 1976)
From an early age he showed interest and ability in science and its methods of observation and experimentation. He pursued this throughout high school becoming science club president (also teaching physics, chemistry and biology courses at this school) He continued with this interest at Northeastern University in Boston, Mass., in a power systems engineering program. While there he saw the assignments of students from a nearby art school, as the students from that school would come into the local hardware store where he was employed. He noticed the type of hands-on problem solving they were undertaking, and felt that this approach was more coherent with his preference to the spirit of exploration. After a few years, he returned to San Juan, where he evaluated his interests and applied to and was awarded full scholarship to Escuela de Artes Plásticas de Puerto Rico. He excelled in his school curriculum, and in extracurricular activities, which took the forms of life size mazes, scavenger hunt games, and many appropriated spaces for events. He was always considered the practical engineer of the bunch, and would often design and build tools and apparatus’ for the creation or simplification of projects or tasks. Since then, he has lived and worked in Miami, been a part of art groups such as M&M projects, Galería Comercial, as well as a designer, fabricator, and collaborator for artists and production companies. Although he worked anonymously for many years in coherence to a research piece, he recently began showing work under his own name, in venues in Puerto Rico, London, and Miami. His approach to art and design has been para-scientific and holistic, emphasizing the poetry of inspiration and craft, as well as a striving to the utopian and fantastic.

inventory.name: Cristian Sebastián – Colección Reyes Veray
inventory.description:
Cristian Sebastián
 (San Juan, P.R., 1984)
Artista plástico y bailarín. Completó su Bachillerato en Publicidad y Relaciones Públicas en la Universidad de Puerto Rico. Formó parte de los talleres intensivos para profesionales de la Escuela de Artes Plásticas de Puerto Rico. Finalizó el Máster de Artes Escénicas de la Universidad Rey Juan Carlos en Madrid. Ha bailado para las compañías de danza de Puerto Rico Ballet Brío y Andanza, colaborado en producciones teatrales, y cine a nivel local e internacional, y varias campañas publicitarias en TV y cine. Robi Draco Rosa y Rey Charles son algunos de los artistas para quienes ha bailado en videos musicales y presentaciones en vivo. Como profesor, ha dirigido diversos programas/talleres que complementan las destrezas de la danza y la pintura en museos e instituciones públicas y privadas. En Madrid, entrenó con el Ballet de la Real Cámara de Madrid y con el Ballet Nacional de España, de Nacho Duato. También participó en uno de los capítulos de la serie española “Aída”. Junto a el dramaturgo Abdiel Marat presentó “El olor de los machos y de las hembras” en el Living Theather de New York (2010). Participó junto a Cecilia Marta Dance Company en el 2011 Summer Stage en New York. Actualmente reside en Nueva York, y colabora con la compañía Ballet Concierto de Puerto Rico cuyos trabajos incluyen Don Quijote, El Cascanueces, y El Sueño de una Noche de Verano.
zajoricreativo.wix.com/cristiansebastian
Cristian Sebastián
 (San Juan, P.R., 1984)
Plastic artist and dancer. He completed his Bachelor’s Degree in Advertising and Public Relations at the University of Puerto Rico. He was part of the intensive workshops for professionals at the Escuela de Artes Plásticas de Puerto Rico. He completed a Master’s Degree in Performing Arts at the Universidad Rey Juan Carlos in Madrid. He has danced for the Puerto Rican dance companies Ballet Brío and Andanza, collaborated in theater and film productions locally and internationally, and several TV and film advertising campaigns. Robi Draco Rosa and Rey Charles are some of the artists for whom he has danced in music videos and live performances. As a teacher, he has conducted several programs/workshops that complement dance and painting skills in museums, and public and private institutions. In Madrid, he trained with the Ballet de la Real Cámara de Madrid and with Nacho Duato’s Ballet Nacional de España. He also participated in one of the chapters of the Spanish series “Aida”. Together with the playwright Abdiel Marat he presented “El olor de los machos y de las hembras” at the Living Theater in New York (2010). He participated with Cecilia Marta Dance Company in the 2011 Summer Stage in New York. He currently resides in New York, and collaborates with Ballet Concierto de Puerto Rico whose works include Don Quixote, The Nutcracker, and A Midsummer Night’s Dream.
